question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"enchanting"** means something that is delightfully charming or attractive. (मोहक)

 
 
• **Example:** The **enchanting** beauty of the forest left us spellbound.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank no. 5 is **'enchanting'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Surprising **(आश्चर्यजनक): Causing wonder or astonishment.

 
 
• **Example:** It was **surprising** to see him at the party after so many years.
 
 
 
• **Abnormal **(असामान्य): Deviating from what is normal or usual.
 
 
• **Example:** The **abnormal** weather patterns are causing concern among scientists.
 
 
 
• **Ordinary **(साधारण): With no special or distinctive features; normal.
 
 
• **Example:** It was just an **ordinary **day at the office.
